description: Directed component dependency graph for ShopSphere. Edges mean 'depends on' (caller -> callee). Frontend pages are static HTML/JS served by the same Express process as the API they call.
independence_caveat: Independence above is scoped to the checkout/shipping change chain only: the catalogue and profile pages/routes do not call shopsphere.server.checkout or shopsphere.server.shipping and are not affected by a shipping-policy.json change. They are NOT independent at runtime in every sense -- all routes are served by the same single Express process (server/app.js), so a process-level crash, a change to server/app.js's shared middleware (body parsing, static file serving, the error handler), or a change to server/data/products.js (read by both the catalogue page and checkout) affects every component. Do not overclaim full runtime isolation from this graph alone.
